registerAgent(string,address,address).details: The `owner` must be human-verified. The agent subname is registered on the      UserRegistry and the resolver is configured with fine-grained EAC permissions.

params.agentAddress: The operational address of the agent itself.
params.label: The agent's label (e.g. "agent-1"). Final name: `label.ROOT_NAME`.
params.owner: The human owner of the agent's name (receives registry + resolver roles).

returns.node: The namehash of the agent's ENS name.

HUMAN_VERIFICATION().notice: Tracks which humans are verified through World Selfie Check.

LEASE_DURATION().notice: Duration of agent name lease in seconds.

PLATFORM().notice: The address that may reconfigure the registrar (e.g. revoke agents).

REPUTATION().notice: The contract that owns reputation score write-permissions.

RESOLVER().notice: The ENSv2 PermissionedResolver that holds agent records.

ROOT_NAME().notice: The root name under which agents are registered (e.g. "mypassport.eth").

USER_REGISTRY().notice: The ENSv2 subname registry that mints agent names.

registerAgent(string,address,address).notice: Register a new agent under the platform root name.

revokeAgent(string).notice: Unregister (shut down) an agent. Platform only.
